about: Corpus manifest of fdk-aac-rs (PORTING.md, "End-to-end corpus"). Read and maintained by scripts/corpus.py. Paths are relative to work/. No test material is committed: external files are referenced by SHA-256, conformance files through ISO's MD5 list, Fraunhofer streams by URL (local only), synthetic signals by generator code and digest.

harness.note: Entries use the options of fdkdec-ref / fdkenc-ref (PORTING.md, "Reference harness"): -t TRANSPORT, --param NAME=VALUE with the C enum names of aacdecoder_lib.h / aacenc_lib.h, -f s16le --rate --channels, --anc FILE, --meta KEY=VALUE. {work} in args is replaced by the work directory; -o and -l are added by scripts/e2e.py.

fraunhofer.notice: Fraunhofer IIS playback test streams: personal use only (imprint: "Permission is granted to download or print material published on this site for personal use only."). They are never fetched by shared tooling. Sizes are the Content-Length of a HEAD request on 2026-10-04; sha256 is null until a developer records it with `scripts/corpus.py fraunhofer --pin`.

iso_23003_7.note: No MD5 list is published; the files are checked against the CRC-32 of the archive directory, and index.json records their MD5.

synthetic.channel_note: Channel c is the mono signal rotated by c * channel_shift_ms, in MPEG channel order.

matrix.note: the synthetic inputs referenced by the encoder cases

constraints: C1: hev2 and eldv2 take stereo input only (aacenc_lib.h; measured: AOT 29 with mono input, aacEncEncode init returns 0x42)

C2: frame lengths: 1024 for the AAC-LC family; 512/480 for LD, ELD+SBR and ELDv2; 512/480/256/240/128/120 for ELD without SBR (measured: other lengths give init 0x23; aacEncoder_SetParam rejects 960 with 0x23)
C3: input rates: HE-AAC, HE-AAC v2 and MPEG-2 HE-AAC 16-96 kHz; ELD+SBR and ELDv2 16-48 kHz; others 8-96 kHz (measured: init 0x23 outside)
C4: ADIF and ADTS only with AOT 2, 5, 29, 129, 132 (measured: LD and ELD give init 0x43)
C5: (none: every signaling mode is accepted with ADIF and ADTS, measured)
C6: AudioMuxVersion varies only with LATM/LOAS (else 0)
C7: explicit backward-compatible signaling (1) with LATM/LOAS needs AudioMuxVersion >= 1 (measured: init 0x23 with AudioMuxVersion 0)
C8: CRC varies only with ADTS (aacenc_lib.h: AACENC_PROTECTION)
C9: signaling varies only with profiles that have an extension AOT (it has no effect on ELD)
C10: channel order varies only with three or more channels
C11: VBR for every profile (measured: modes 1, 3, 5 accepted with AOT 2, 5, 23, 39)
C12: LD and ELD profiles not with MODE_7_1_REAR_SURROUND (33) (measured: init 0x23 for AOT 23 and 39)

explicit_cases.note: SetParam(AACENC_GRANULE_LENGTH, 960) returns 0x23 (measured); the encoder then runs with 1024

explicit_cases.note: raw access units for DAB+-style decoding; 960 is not available from the encoder (enc-x-960)

anc_file.note: line k: the 16 bytes (16k + i) & 0xff, hex

encoder_matrix.metadata_note: AACENC_MetaData fields (Q16 dB where the struct says dB): the same set for metadata modes 1-3; the encoder uses the fields that the mode writes.
encoder_matrix.constraints_measured: Validity measured on 2026-10-04 with fdkenc-ref (ref-arm64) on syn_sweep inputs, 2 channels, AACENC_BITRATE=64000 unless noted.
